purpose: Define when page264 may safely release exclusive WordPress write scope to a later page without treating tool unavailability or a read-only checkpoint as completion.
scope_authority: STATE.md remains PAGE264 ONLY until these criteria are actually proven and the full state history is safely preserved during a normal handoff.
blocking_write_capable_items: Fresh trustworthy source/target live gate for v006 request-contact foreground.
Fresh trustworthy source/target live gate for v007 desktop comparison equal-column parity.
If either/both still fail, exactly one selected repository artifact/bundle insertion through oldtrees-next-remote-window-v004 plus mandatory server/browser readback.
If neither fails, explicit fresh evidence that both are already source-equivalent and no v006/v007 write is required.
mandatory_release_evidence: Intended +5 WPVibe identity, target site connection and exact quota were verified in the successful live closeout window; >=10 D11 reserve preserved.
Fresh page264 _elementor_data bytes/SHA/JSON reconciled and valid.
Additional CSS has exactly one af-project:end, exactly one accepted v004 and v005 marker, and any selected v006/v007 marker exactly once; no unreconciled duplicate/partial marker.
Changed-section source/target visual check confirms the selected v006/v007 outcome and no regression to accepted v004/v005 surfaces/geometry.
No unresolved 429/5xx write outcome remains; every uncertain mutation was converted to exact readback before further action.
No other page264-specific prepared write remains justified by fresh reproduced evidence.
items_allowed_to_remain_open_after_relea: Form33 service/topic native-required configuration and safe non-delivery behavior, provided no fallback code has been justified from a reproduced native failure.
Inner MetForm field visual measurements when no synchronized defect has been proven.
Read-only route/href confirmation when no route mismatch is reproduced.
Review/Tiszafa/Nordmann/four-FAQ direct interaction acceptance when action tooling is unavailable and no failure is reproduced.
Hero exact owner/cascade diagnosis when the observed offset has no proven writable owner.
Floating-dock owner discovery when the owner is global/unproven and no strictly page264-scoped correction is justified.
Deterministic six-view pixel/overlay acceptance while the original/replacement harness remains unavailable.
release_forbidden_if: v006 or v007 is still a reproduced failure without completed write/readback or explicit no-write PASS evidence.
Current page/hash/marker state is unknown or drift is unexplained.
Any page264-specific fix is merely prepared but not reconciled against fresh live truth.
A 429/5xx mutation outcome is still UNKNOWN.
STATE.md cannot be safely updated while preserving complete history.
A parallel page264 QA/write owner is still active.
Release is being inferred only because WPVibe/Opera/public HTTP is unavailable.
handoff_contract_after_release: Re-read fresh STATE.md and latest page264 continuation immediately before handoff.
Preserve all existing STATE history; never truncate the file to force a scope switch.
Record page264 closed implementation state and remaining proof-only/formal blockers separately.
Only then allow the next page handoff plan (for example bio-scope-handoff-ready-v002) to take write scope.
Shared Opera tabs must be explicitly released; the next page reuses at most those two, with no replacement fan-out.
current_reason_not_released: WPVibe/Opera live gates are unavailable in this continuation and v006/v007 remain reproduced conditional implementation candidates. Static preparation alone cannot close them.
